sources.entry: Postbox - Powerful, simple and beautiful email client, need to pay for a license.

summary.name: Postbox
summary.one_liner: Postbox is a desktop email client for macOS and Windows aimed at power users, with keyboard-driven triage, a Quick Bar, and customizable themes and layouts.
use_cases: move or label many emails at once
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Postbox as a fast email app with a Quick Bar that works like Spotlight for email actions: moving or copying messages, switching folders, tagging or labeling, and navigating folders via keystrokes. It supports keyboard shortcuts, filters and rules, and swipe actions on macOS. It offers composition tools for writing email. Interface customization includes showing or hiding panels, vertical or horizontal message views, Favorites Bar or tabs for folders, and pinning important messages to the top of the list. Users can build a theme with a Theme Editor or add a professionally designed Theme Pack.
notable: Quick Bar for keyboard-driven email actions, similar to Spotlight
Theme Editor and Theme Pack for interface customization
Vertical and horizontal message list views with pinning and Favorites Bar
caveats: Requires a license to pay for (per awesome-mac listing)
Swipe actions are noted as macOS-only on the page
